title: Trade Into the Mate
setup: Black's bishop on d7 is propping up the rook on c8 while your queen waits on d6.
hint: Two defenders can look like twice the defense. Check whether they are guarding the same square or covering for one another.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxc8+}} is a straight trade, but {{Bxc8}} drags the bishop off d7 and opens the d-file, so {{Qd8#}} follows. Blocking with {{Be8}} instead runs into {{Rxe8#}}. The bishop was guarding the rook and shutting the d-file at once, and it cannot do both.
